_readme: Parámetros del modelo Polku. Cada valor lleva source_id (ver docs/05_fuentes_y_evidencia.md) y confidence: high | medium | low | assumption. La UI debe mostrar 'Estimate' para low/assumption. Editar aquí, no en el código.

phases.label: Specialist access
phases.note: TYKS 9–13 d de media (2024–25); encuesta nórdica 2–4 semanas

benchmark.note: Noruega ≤42 d (cirugía/RT) desde la derivación; Suecia 40/44 d desde sospecha fundada (S07). Editable.

entry_routes._note: Segundo eje de equidad (docs/10). Multiplicadores relativos tomados de DLBCL (Kuitunen 2026) y trasladados a pulmón como SUPUESTO. Calibrar para que la media nacional ponderada siga reproduciendo las medias de fase.

share_occupational_private.proxy: regional employment rate (15–64) or working-age share of cancer patients; StatFin
share_occupational_private.note: Estrategia pág. 6: ~1/3 de los pacientes con cáncer (todos los tipos) en edad laboral. En pulmón la mayoría está jubilada → bajado a 0,25 (supuesto). Verificar con NORDCAN (edad) o Kaisa.

entry_routes.evidence: DLBCL Finland: symptom→treatment 123 d (private/occupational) vs 207 d (public); symptom→referral 77 vs 147 d.

patient_factors._note: Perfil de paciente (docs/11). Multiplicadores relativos por fase; el motor los normaliza con las proporciones para que la media nacional no cambie. Fases no listadas = 1.

education.evidence: AZ briefing (Kuitunen): lower SES associated with longer time to treatment (DLBCL). Zai 2025: lower education → more lung cancer, later stage, less surgery. Effect sizes on days are team assumptions (health literacy → help-seeking).

navigation_barrier.label: Barriers to navigating care (lives alone, other language, or 75+)
navigation_barrier.evidence: AZ briefing slides 8 and 10: limited health literacy, fragmented pathways and hand-offs; gaps for vulnerable populations. Effect sizes are team assumptions.

distance.note: Distancia del perfil relativa a la referencia nacional, con las elasticidades de dist_central (P1, P4) y dist_rt (P5). fallback_region_km = distancia supuesta mientras no haya datos reales de distancia por región.

pathway_steps._note: 8 pasos de la diapositiva 10 de AZ (S27) y cómo se reparten las 5 fases del modelo. Repartos = supuesto.

prioritisation.note: Score = (1-w)·días ahorrados (paciente medio, normalizado) + w·brecha cerrada (perfil peor vs mejor, normalizada). Sin euros: el esfuerzo es cualitativo y explícito.

outcome_context._note: Datos REALES (no modelados) para la tarjeta 'Why days matter'.

education_gap.note: Zai et al. BMJ Public Health 2025, todos los cánceres, Finlandia 2000–2019

regional_drivers.indicator: 1 - share of adults seeing a GP within 14 days
share waiting > 3 (or 6) months in specialist care
population-weighted km to nearest radiotherapy / university hospital
inverse socioeconomic index (e.g. 1 / share with tertiary education)

interventions.label: Standardised fast-track pathway (Nordic model)
interventions.evidence: Denmark CPP: wait to diagnosis 49→35 d; Norway: optimal work-up could lift within-target 40%→80%; Sweden SVF: only 36% meet lead-time targets (implementation risk). Wales DES: ~20 days saved with first outpatient ≤7 d + streamlined tests.
interventions.cost_note: Within roadmap action 3.1.1 budget: 5 M€/year, 25 M€ over 5 years nationally (covers 2.5.2, 3.1.2–3.1.4, 4.3.2).

interventions.label: e-consultation primary care ↔ pulmonology
interventions.evidence: Systematic review: specialist response 4.6 h–3.9 d; LA County median wait 63→52 d; RCT 5 vs 24 d. Not cancer-specific.
interventions.cost_note: Part of roadmap action 3.5.3: 1.14 M€ nationally for digital pathways and AI tools.

interventions.label: Named care coordinator / nurse navigator
interventions.evidence: Observational: BC Cancer referral→systemic therapy 48→38 d; Akron suspicion→treatment 64→45 d. Targeted at patients with navigation barriers (extra effect on the referral hand-off = assumption).
interventions.cost_note: Staff cost. Assumption: 1 FTE per ~100 lung cancer cases/year.

interventions.label: Direct CT access from primary care
interventions.evidence: Danish cluster RCT (Aarhus): no significant reduction in time to diagnosis or stage (ITT). Finland has the fewest CT scanners per capita in the Nordics.

interventions.label: Named GP / continuity of care (omalääkäri)
interventions.evidence: Continuity of care rationale; no lung-specific effect size found.

interventions.label: Multilingual symptom-awareness and anti-stigma campaign
interventions.evidence: Roadmap p.23: lung cancer stigma delays help-seeking. Strategy 1.3: culturally adapted communication. No effect size found.

interventions.label: Remote oncology consultations + travel coordination
interventions.evidence: Roadmap p.13 (deliver what can be decentralised close to home); Paakkola 2024: >50 km from hospital HR 1.47 for 12-month mortality.

interventions.label: Public fast lane for suspected cancer (close the public/private gap)
interventions.evidence: Inverse care law: public route reaches treatment ~84 days later than occupational/private in Finnish DLBCL data, mostly before referral. Effect size is an assumption.
interventions.cost_note: Within standardised referral criteria work (3.1.1 budget).

interventions.label: Travel coordination and cost cover for remote / low-income patients
interventions.evidence: Out-of-pocket fees and travel costs delay investigations and discourage screening (AstraZeneca briefing, slide 5); >50 km associated with worse lung cancer outcomes (S18).
interventions.cost_note: Kela travel reimbursement + county transport coordination.

interventions.label: Minimum dataset: symptom, referral and treatment dates + entry route + education
interventions.evidence: Strategy p.30: symptom-to-diagnosis not collected systematically; stage recorded for only ~40% of cases.
